name: Player Balance: Outbound call succeeds
description: Issue #8: sbo's findAccount() outbound call succeeds (error.id == 0). Legacy known defect, StationHubNext 是否沿用待決: PlayBalanceResource::toArray() treats the float PlayerService::getPlayBalance() returns as an array, so even a successful outbound call yields a 200 with a PHP ErrorException message instead of a balance payload — see .legacy-src PlayBalanceResource/PlayerController.

queries.name: sbo_wallet
queries.sql: SELECT id, balance, freeze, player_id FROM wallets WHERE platform_id = 3 AND user_id = 1

queries.name: sbo_player
queries.sql: SELECT id, account, vendor_player_id, playing FROM players WHERE station_id = 1 AND platform_id = 3
